Indikator 10 tracks the mortality rate among prevalent atrial fibrillation patients across [[danmark|Danmark]] and its five administrative regions. For the period spanning July 1, 2022, to June 30, 2023, the national mortality rate stood at 7.6% [^src1]. None of the geographic entities met the established clinical standard, as the "Standard opfyldt" (standard met) metric remained at 0% across the entire country and all regions [^src1].

When comparing regional performance for the 2022/23 period, [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] recorded the highest mortality rate at 7.9%, making it the trailer in terms of patient survival [^src1]. Conversely, [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] emerged as the leader with the lowest mortality rate at 7.4% [^src1]. The remaining regions clustered tightly around the national average, with [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] and [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] both reporting 7.5%, and [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] matching the national rate of 7.6% [^src1].

An analysis of historical columns reveals a distinct trend of increased mortality during the 2021/22 period, followed by a general improvement in 2022/23. Nationally, mortality rose from 7.5% in 2020/21 to a peak of 8.0% in 2021/22, before falling back to 7.6% in the most recent period [^src1]. This pattern was mirrored in all regions, with [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] and [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] exhibiting the most volatility; Nordjylland spiked from 7.3% to 8.2% before dropping to 7.5%, while Syddanmark peaked at 8.3% before settling at 7.9% [^src1]. Notably, [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] and [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] were the only regions to ultimately reduce their mortality rates in 2022/23 below their respective 2020/21 baselines of 7.2% and 7.3% [^src1].

Summary: Tabellen sammenligner mortalitetsandelen for prævalente atrieflimren-patienter på nationalt, regionalt og kommunalt niveau for perioden 01.07.2022–30.06.2023, og viser en landsomfattende andel på 7,6 % med regional variation fra 7,4 % (Midtjylland) til 7,9 % (Syddanmark).
